claims: Reassess pain and titrate opioid analgesia (hydromorphone/fentanyl/oxycodone) to maintain comfort, monitoring respiratory status given recent opioid administration.
Continue heparin infusion with periodic aPTT monitoring and assess for bleeding, given therapeutic anticoagulation and falling hemoglobin/hematocrit.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit serially and evaluate for occult bleeding or hemodilution given downward trend (11 to 10.1 g/dL; Hct 30.5% to 29.6%).
Replete potassium given serum K 3.4 mEq/L, with follow-up basic metabolic panel.
Maintain continuous cardiac and pulse oximetry monitoring with alarms, given tachycardia (HR up to 107), borderline SpO2 (93-95%), and bedfast status.
Perform fall-risk precautions and assist with mobility given bedfast status, impaired orientation/forgets limitations, and JH-HLM 2b.
Provide nutrition support assessment and interventions given Braden nutrition score 'probably inadequate' and bedfast activity.
Continue dextrose 5% infusion and monitor glucose, with point-of-care glucose checks as needed.
Monitor temperature and assess for infection given leukocytosis (WBC 11.7 to 10.4 K/uL) and secondary diagnosis present.
Reassess neurologic status and delirium risk (CAM-ICU, RASS) each shift given fluctuating orientation and sedative/opioid exposure.
